decisions.situation: Post-transformation (zombie period), his new form trades speed for resilience and changes how all social masks work.
decisions.objective: Rebuild the operational model around the new body.
known_facts: the form repels normal social integration
resilience enables previously suicidal tactics
old allies may not recognize him
unknowns: who benefits from his presumed death
options: rush to restore the old body
reprice everything: redesign tactics around resilience, exploit presumed-death cover, and build identities impossible for the old body
decisions.selected_action: reprice everything: redesign tactics around resilience, exploit presumed-death cover, and build identities impossible for the old body
result: new operational doctrine fitted to the actual body
lesson: price the body you have, not the body you lost
presumed death is a strategic reset button

decisions.situation: An enemy heir hunts him with a treasure that counters his signature Gu set.
known_facts: counter-treasures are built against known signatures
his reputation document his Gu set
signature changes are possible but costly
options: fight below the signature: use disposable unrecorded Gu for the counter-treasure's debut, waste its charges on decoys, then retire the countered set for that season
decisions.selected_action: fight below the signature: use disposable unrecorded Gu for the counter-treasure's debut, waste its charges on decoys, then retire the countered set for that season
result: counter-treasure spent on noise; signature doctrine adjusted
lesson: counter-weapons are one-shot economics if fed decoys
signatures are seasonal, not permanent

decisions.situation: A wisdom-path deduction service is available at ruinous price.
known_facts: deduction services price by difficulty and urgency
his own questions are often answerable by restructure
the service's accuracy is verifiable on known-answer tests
unknowns: whether the service sells his questions onward
options: partition the question: buy only the unverifiable core at standard urgency after passing the service through known-answer tests
decisions.selected_action: partition the question: buy only the unverifiable core after passing the service through known-answer tests
result: core question answered at fair price; leak surface minimized
lesson: test the oracle before trusting it
buy answers, never the feeling of certainty

decisions.situation: His information network's reports arrive faster than his verification can cycle.
known_facts: verification latency creates decision windows
unverified action creates bait exposure
report grading can be automated by source track record
unknowns: which sources are compromised this quarter
options: tier the flow: source-graded auto-actions for small reversible matters, hedged partial actions on medium matters, full verification only for irreversible ones
decisions.selected_action: tier the flow: source-graded auto-actions for small reversible matters, hedged partial actions on medium matters, full verification only for irreversible ones
result: decision velocity preserved; bait exposure capped
lesson: match verification depth to irreversibility
hedges are how you act before you know

decisions.situation: A minor immortal proposes a joint expedition into a pocket world with strict entry limits.
known_facts: pocket worlds enforce their own rules
entry limits make team composition decisive
expedition splits breed violence at the treasure stage
options: accept with pre-agreed split formulas, role locks, and a rule-mapping phase before any treasure contact
decisions.selected_action: accept with pre-agreed split formulas, role locks, and a rule-mapping phase before any treasure contact
result: expedition survived the treasure stage that kills most teams
lesson: write the split before the treasure exists
map the world's rules before touching its rewards

decisions.situation: An old enemy on his deathbed offers his full archive for care of his descendants.
decisions.objective: Price the archive against the obligation.
known_facts: archives depreciate as context decays
descendant care is a decades-long liability
the dying enemy's faction will watch the arrangement
unknowns: whether the archive is genuine and complete
options: accept a scoped version: archive delivered now against assessment, descendants enter the standard probation pipeline, care ends at majority
decisions.selected_action: accept a scoped version: archive delivered now against assessment, descendants enter the standard probation pipeline, care ends at majority
result: archive acquired at fair scope; obligation bounded
lesson: even enemies' legacies can be bought at scope
bound the obligation before the dying hand lets go

decisions.situation: A fault in his essence-quality concealment appears: one clan aunt with an old nose Gu smells the difference.
known_facts: the aunt's social position is low but her nose is real
killing her creates a family storm
she trades gossip for kindness
options: befriend her genuinely within the mask, supply aromatic masking, and let her gossip carry harmless explanations
decisions.selected_action: befriend her genuinely within the mask, supply aromatic masking, and let her gossip carry harmless explanations
result: the nose became a rumor shield
lesson: low-position witnesses are best handled by kindness, not silence
use the gossip network to install the explanation

decisions.situation: A faction offers a fixed annuity for his public non-aggression.
known_facts: non-aggression annuities fund from fear
accepting prices his future attacks upward
the faction announces the arrangement to deter others
options: accept, then quietly sell non-aggression to their rivals too — pricing the same fear to everyone who pays
decisions.selected_action: accept, then quietly sell non-aggression to their rivals too
decisions.cost: restraint maintenance (which he would exercise anyway)
result: fear converted into a diversified income stream
lesson: sell your restraint to every buyer of it
non-aggression is a product with many markets

decisions.situation: He can acquire a rival's entire operation at distressed price if he acts before their creditor auction.
known_facts: auction prices bottom at the gavel
pre-auction private deals price higher but exclude rival bidders
the rival's fall is already priced by insiders
options: private pre-auction purchase of selected assets (the craftsman contracts, not the debt) — let the auction clear the liabilities
decisions.selected_action: private pre-auction purchase of selected assets — let the auction clear the liabilities
decisions.cost: higher unit prices on selected assets
result: assets acquired clean; liabilities left to the auction
lesson: buy the engines, let the gavel sell the debts
selective acquisition beats package pricing

decisions.situation: A face-saving concession he offered in negotiation was treated as weakness and escalated.
known_facts: concessions read as floors, not gifts
the counterparty's culture prices generosity differently
escalation continued until firmly stopped
options: freeze all concessions, display one expensive cost imposition, then reopen at the original floor with a new middle option
decisions.selected_action: freeze all concessions, display one expensive cost imposition, then reopen at the original floor with a new middle option
result: escalation stopped; negotiation resumed on his floor
lesson: concessions need price tags and cliffs
stop escalation with a demonstration, not a gift

decisions.situation: His weighted decision scores predicted success but the option failed — the model double-counted a correlated risk (same supplier backing two option legs).
known_facts: correlated risks masquerade as diversification
his scoring treated dependent legs as independent
the supplier's failure killed both legs
unknowns: what other correlations hide in his books
options: build a dependency graph across all option legs, stress-test correlated failure, and cap exposure per underlying node
decisions.selected_action: build a dependency graph across all option legs, stress-test correlated failure, and cap exposure per underlying node
result: correlated-failure class closed
lesson: diversification is a graph property, not a count
one node failing should never fell two legs

decisions.situation: An over-performing subordinate built a private power base and began negotiating terms.
decisions.objective: Restore balance without destroying the asset.
known_facts: power bases grow from delegated dependency
the asset's capability is real
public confrontations solidify factions
options: quietly restructure dependencies (rotate access, seed successors), then renegotiate from restored balance — or let the restructure price them out
decisions.selected_action: quietly restructure dependencies, then renegotiate from restored balance
result: balance restored; asset retained under original terms or departed cheaply
lesson: prune dependency growth before negotiating with it
power bases feed on static org charts

decisions.situation: A diplomatic mask was burned when an ally of the persona committed a crime and the persona was expected to answer for him.
known_facts: personas inherit their allies' crimes
public dissociation looks like betrayal
the crime's severity makes defense impossible
unknowns: whether the ally can be extracted
options: choreograph a principled break: the persona condemns and personally delivers the ally to justice, then retires the persona on schedule with dignity intact
decisions.selected_action: choreograph a principled break: deliver the ally to justice, then retire the persona on schedule
result: mask's honor survived; successor persona inherits clean
lesson: allies' crimes are prepaid liabilities of every persona
retire the mask with honor so the next mask can inherit trust

decisions.situation: A rival faction plants a spy who is genuinely talented and genuinely sympathetic.
decisions.objective: Use the spy without sentiment or cruelty.
known_facts: the spy's reports are expected by their handler
talented spies are worth re-recruiting
detection ends the spy's utility either way
options: feed controlled information while quietly recruiting — their handler becomes his channel
decisions.selected_action: feed controlled information while quietly recruiting — their handler becomes his channel
result: the enemy's intelligence channel inverted
lesson: discovered spies are infrastructure, not threats
the handler is the real target; the spy is the socket

decisions.situation: His persona's local community expects participation in a blood feud between two other families.
decisions.objective: Enter the feud at zero cost.
known_facts: neutrality is read as cowardice by both sides
mediation is a respected role
feuds burn out on their own schedule
options: enter late as the mediator who delivers the peace both bleeding sides need — collecting honor from the winner and gratitude from the loser
decisions.selected_action: enter late as the mediator — collecting honor from the winner and gratitude from the loser
result: feud harvested for honor; no blood debt
lesson: sell the peace after the war prices it
the mediator collects from both graves

decisions.situation: His mask persona is invited to view a rare treasure owned by a jealous collector.
known_facts: collectors read viewers' pupils and pauses
desire signals reprice or endanger
his expertise risks authentic reactions
options: view with expert-curiosity spread across many items, spending more attention on decoys, and exit before the target item gets a second look
decisions.selected_action: view with expert-curiosity spread across many items, spending more attention on decoys, and exit before the target item gets a second look
result: assessment made; desire unread
lesson: curiosity is a resource; budget it like money
one glance is data; two is a bid

decisions.situation: He needs a formation's blueprint held in a faction's restricted library.
known_facts: restricted libraries lend to accredited scholars
copies degrade but blueprint math survives transcription
librarians trade favors for scarce texts
options: buy from a corrupt librarian (permanent blackmailer)
enter as an accredited scholar on a legitimate research program, transcribe under allowed note-taking, and trade scarce texts for the restricted pages
decisions.selected_action: enter as an accredited scholar and trade scarce texts for the restricted pages
result: blueprint acquired through the front door
lesson: most vaults have a scholarship door
trade what is rare to you and cheap to them

decisions.situation: A pursuer forces him into terrain where his movement Gu underperforms.
known_facts: pursuers optimize for open pursuit
terrain flips specialization advantages
escapes teach pursuers his patterns
options: drag pursuit into terrain where the pursuer's advantages invert, dispose of them there, and leave a decoy trail pointing elsewhere
decisions.selected_action: drag pursuit into terrain where advantages invert, dispose, and leave a decoy trail
result: pursuer neutralized; pattern library polluted
lesson: choose the ground that inverts the hunt
every escape should teach the pursuer a lie

decisions.situation: Two of his informant chains start reporting conflicting pictures of the same event.
decisions.objective: Resolve the conflict without freezing decisions.
known_facts: conflicting reports mean at least one compromised or mis-positioned chain
the event's reality is checkable at its physical layer
freezing decisions is itself a cost
options: verify at the physical layer (markets, weather, bodies) and stage decisions to survive either report being true
decisions.selected_action: verify at the physical layer and stage decisions to survive either report being true
result: reality anchored; compromised chain isolated later
lesson: when reports conflict, ask the ground
staged decisions are immune to informant wars

decisions.situation: A promising recruit turns out to be fleeing a blood debt to a faction he deals with.
known_facts: blood debts follow the debtor, not the employer
harboring creates faction friction
the recruit's talent is real
options: broker the debt: price it, pay or structure it, and convert the recruit's gratitude into performance — with the faction as creditor, not enemy
decisions.selected_action: broker the debt and convert gratitude into performance
result: talent retained; faction converted to creditor
lesson: debts are tradeable; grudges are not
become the broker of your people's burdens

decisions.situation: A monopolist supplier squeezes a critical input's price seasonally.
known_facts: monopolists squeeze where alternatives are slowest

demand-side coordination is legally risky
options: coordinate inventory timing among small buyers (legal, private) and fund one substitute pilot — making the squeeze unprofitable at its peak
decisions.selected_action: coordinate inventory timing among small buyers and fund one substitute pilot
result: squeeze peak blunted; substitute option seeded
lesson: timing coordination is legal collusion at small scale
monopolists fear calendars more than rivals

decisions.situation: He is offered payment in reputation endorsements rather than currency.
known_facts: endorsements transfer credibility and its risks

options: accept endorsements with scope limits (named use-cases only), scandal-severance clauses, and expiry dates
decisions.selected_action: accept endorsements with scope limits, scandal-severance clauses, and expiry dates
result: reputation monetized without unlimited liability
lesson: sell reputation by the slice, never the whole pie

decisions.situation: A wedding he attended under a mask was remembered by a child who later recognized his gait in another persona.
known_facts: children index motion patterns better than faces

the child's claim will sound absurd to adults
unknowns: whether the child spoke to anyone
options: modify gait signatures across all personas, seed a harmless explanation through the child's trusted adults, and log the linkage for monitoring
decisions.selected_action: modify gait signatures and seed a harmless explanation through trusted adults
result: linkage dissolved into a funny family story
lesson: your body is your signature; train it or rotate it

decisions.situation: He over-invested in one region's markets and a regional ban stranded a third of his capital.
known_facts: regional bans are correlated risks

extraction takes longer than entry

decisions.selected_action: institutionalize exposure caps per jurisdiction with scheduled rebalancing and standing extraction plans
result: concentration risk capped going forward
lesson: capital sleeps in regions; bans wake it

decisions.situation: A local festival names his persona as judge of a contested ritual honor.
known_facts: judging creates a loser who remembers

the honor's stakes are symbolic
options: publish transparent criteria, award by them, and create an honorable named consolation that the loser's family values more than the original prize
decisions.selected_action: publish criteria, award by them, and create an honorable consolation the loser values more
result: judgment accepted; loser upgraded socially
lesson: lose the argument to the criteria, win the peace with design

decisions.situation: A mysterious stranger correctly guesses one true detail about his buried past under the mask.
known_facts: one true detail proves research, not certainty

decisions.situation: A plague sweeps the region; his supply lines depend on affected routes.

decisions.situation: A partnership offer arrives with an unusually generous profit split.
